why: The 3-2-1 routine is a narrower reading-specific combination centered on summarizing text, sharing salient points, and generating a question, so it belongs as an example under Summarization and Synthesis rather than as a separate element.

claims.verifier: The study directly tests a summarization strategy and reports a null effect on learners’ summary performance, appropriately counting against the practice.
